title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR David Mitchell’s first novel, Ghostwritten , was awarded the Mail on Sunday/John Llewellyn Rhys Prize for the best book by a writer under thirty-five, and was shortlisted for the Guardian First Book Award. His second novel, Number9Dream , followed in 2002 and was shortlisted for the Booker Prize as well as the James Tait Black Memorial Prize. In 2003, David Mitchell was selected as one of the Best of Young British Novelists by Granta . He also returned to Britain from Japan, where he spent eight years, and now lives in Ireland.
